summary: DriveItAway Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K on August 18, 2026, announcing its board's decision to voluntarily terminate registration of its common stock under Section 12(g) of the Exchange Act and suspend reporting obligations under Sections 13(a) and 15(d). The company filed a Form 15 on August 18, 2026, which immediately suspended its reporting duties; deregistration is expected effective 90 days after filing. The company cited disproportionate compliance costs relative to its size and stated it will provide financial information through OTC Markets' Alternative Reporting Standard to maintain quotation on the current-information tier. The move is a voluntary deregistration, not tied to a transaction.
